windowTitle: Serial integration stage 7 - Console cloud mode build and observable mode distinction
scope: Establish the §11.7 'explicit Console cloud mode' source fact: the VITE_CONSOLE_IDENTITY=cloud build compiles, and its emitted bundle differs observably from the legacy default (the cloud build exposes the Publisher route). No production source changed; the build artifacts were removed after the check.

findings.fact: `VITE_CONSOLE_IDENTITY=cloud npm run build` (vite build) completed successfully: 2814 modules transformed, dist emitted. The Console identity is read at `apps/console-ui/src/app/console-identity.ts` and gates the Publisher/Agent routes in `apps/console-ui/src/app/console-router.ts`.
findings.consequence: The cloud-mode Console bundle is producible from the exact source SHA.

findings.fact: The emitted bundle distinguishes the two modes: the cloud build contains the Publisher surface marker `发布 Package` twice, while the legacy-default build contains it once.
findings.consequence: Selecting VITE_CONSOLE_IDENTITY=cloud has an observable effect on the built product, not a no-op.

findings.fact: The product Dockerfile's ARG default remains `VITE_CONSOLE_IDENTITY=legacy` and no Cloud build path (Candidate/release/qualification workflow) passes `cloud`.
findings.consequence: An installed product image still builds the legacy Console by default; explicitly shipping the cloud Console is an open decision for the Instance/Candidate path and is recorded, not assumed.

notRun: Full product image build (Docker Hub is unreachable from this local host: auth.docker.io i/o timeout, so the pinned base/CLI images cannot be pulled and no fully offline build is possible here).
Candidate build (owner-actor dispatch), Instance deployment, production readback.
Console end-to-end business chain from the cloud-mode bundle against a live BFF.
claimBoundary: This receipt claims the Console cloud-mode build compiles and produces a bundle observably distinct from the legacy default. It does not claim a Candidate image, an installed product, or that the cloud Console is the shipped default.
